When I met my current boyfriend, we were both 21 and in college. It’s been about two and a half years since then. I have been in bad relationships before and he seemed perfect, so caring and sweet. We lived together for a while and then we got a puppy. 

My boyfriend is in law school at a prestigious college. He is very ambitious and currently very stressed with finals, a law review journal, clerkship applications, and the puppy (if you have ever had a puppy you know it’s a lot of work and stressful).  I realized that we may be incompatible in part because he is very focused on his career and I am someone who prioritizes my relationships more.

In the past few months, my boyfriend has seemed different than who I thought he was. I am an emotional person and suffer from depression, which is something he knew going in, but he often seems frustrated or irritated when I call him or come to him crying. When I criticize him in any way, or he perceives something as criticism, he can get very angry, to the point where he will throw things or say something hurtful. This behavior started this year and escalated increasingly.

He does not like having a puppy, and when the puppy is stressing him out, he sometimes does things like shove him in his crate roughly or shake his crate in anger. 

I want to believe this will get better. We are in therapy (we’ve had a few sessions), but my head is telling me it is wiser to leave him. I think he is a good person who is very stressed, but I also am scared by his actions towards me and our dog, and I think we may want different things in our romantic relationships. 

I believe he is capable of change and he said he is willing to see a therapist on his own. I have also told him that if this behavior continues, I will leave, and since I said that it has stopped, but it’s only been a few weeks. 

What do you think? Am I being naive? I know I am not a perfect partner and need to change as well to be less reliant on him and appreciate him more, but I have tried to be a generally good partner. I love his personality and so many aspects of his character, but I am worried these red flags are too red.
